title: DCT & DSG Compatibility Chart
intro: An advanced lubricant for superior component protection and service reliability in wet dual clutch transmissions (DCT) and direct-shift gearboxes (DSG).
notes: Use in DCT or DSG transmissions according to the equipment manufacturer's recommendations.
do_not_use: CVT, traditional step-shift transmissions, or Nissan transmissions that require GTR fluid.
disclaimer: The vehicle manufacturers listed have not evaluated or endorsed this product. Always follow the equipment manufacturer's recommendations. It is the service technician's responsibility to confirm that this fluid is suitable for a particular vehicle or transmission.
